# Intake: weather/offline-forecast

### Q-1 goal
Asked 2026-11-02: Is the goal that the app shows the last forecast it fetched, and its age, with no network?

#### Q-1 answer, 2026-11-02
> Yes. And it has to say how old it is.

Ruling: → Goal

### Q-2 acceptance
Asked 2026-11-02: Should the fetch time follow the phone's own time format?

#### Q-2 answer, 2026-11-02
> Yes, the reader's own format.

Ruling: → AC-2

### Q-3 platforms
Asked 2026-11-02: Does the forecast need to survive a restart on both phone platforms?

#### Q-3 answer, 2026-11-02
> Both.

Ruling: → AC-3

### Q-4 offline
Asked 2026-11-02: A forecast a day old: should it say its age in words?

#### Q-4 answer, 2026-11-02
> In words, yes.

Ruling: → E-1

### Q-5 offline
Asked 2026-11-02: Weather alerts while offline: in or out?

#### Q-5 answer, 2026-11-02
> Out, alerts have their own task.

Ruling: → O-1

### Q-6 decisions
Asked 2026-11-02: How many days of forecasts to keep?

#### Q-6 answer, 2026-11-02
> Three days, no more.

Ruling: → D-1

### Q-7 large-text
Asked 2026-11-02: Large text: does this change any screen's layout?

#### Q-7 answer, 2026-11-02
> No, the screen keeps its layout.

Ruling: → n/a

### Q-8 offline
Asked 2026-11-02: The offline aspect: AC-1 and E-1 cover it. Accept that as the default?

#### Q-8 answer, 2026-11-02
> Accepted.

Ruling: default accepted → Aspects offline
